_metadata.description: Synthetic educational demo fixtures for WiseCub Member 4 Scam Awareness / Scam Safety. 100% fictional data for local testing; contains no personal, child, or live user information.

safety_simulations.detail: Educational simulation recorded for Level 1 Phishing
safety_simulations.subject: [Urgent Notice] Student Library Storage Quota Exceeded - Account Suspension in 24 Hours
safety_simulations.preview: Your cloud storage quota exceeded the 5GB limit. Unverified accounts will be permanently wiped tonight...
safety_simulations.simulated_body:
Dear Student,

Our system detected that your cloud storage quota exceeded the 5GB limit allocated to student accounts. Because of scheduled server maintenance tonight at midnight, all unverified accounts with exceeded quotas will be permanently wiped.

To prevent your assignments, course notes, and uploaded projects from being deleted, you must verify your student portal identity immediately through the security gateway below.

Thank you,
Student Cloud Support Operations
red_flags_identified: Creates artificial 24-hour urgency to panic the student into reacting without thinking
Threatens devastating consequences (permanent assignment and file deletion)
Unverifiable sender domain ('student-cloud-portal.net' instead of your official school domain)
Directs to an unverified external login gateway to enter credentials

safety_simulations.detail: Educational simulation recorded for Level 2 Scam Text Messages
safety_simulations.subject: Delivery Exception Notice: Action required to release your package #QD-88124
safety_simulations.preview: Your parcel could not be delivered due to an unpaid dispatch fee of $1.85. Confirm address within 2 hours...
safety_simulations.simulated_body:
Notice for Package #QD-88124:

Your parcel could not be delivered to your address this morning due to an unpaid dispatch clearance charge of $1.85. Our driver cannot complete delivery without this mandatory customs fee payment.

Please follow our mobile clearance link within 2 hours to confirm your delivery address and authorize release. Otherwise, your parcel will be marked abandoned and returned to sender.
red_flags_identified: Unexpected package alert when you never ordered anything with this courier
Requests a small fee ($1.85) to lure you into entering credit card details
2-hour countdown designed to rush you into paying without checking with a parent

safety_simulations.detail: Educational simulation recorded for Level 3 Fake QR-Code Offers
safety_simulations.subject: Student Appreciation Perk: Claim your free pizza combo & drink voucher!
safety_simulations.preview: Our campus food partner is giving away 500 free pizza combos today. Scan your coupon token before 5 PM...
safety_simulations.simulated_body:
Congratulations Student!

As part of Student Appreciation Month, our campus food partner is giving away 500 free pizza combos and drink coupons to students today.

To claim your voucher code, click the link below to scan your digital coupon token and enter your mobile phone number. Vouchers are strictly first-come, first-served and expire at 5:00 PM today!
red_flags_identified: Unsolicited free food voucher from an unofficial third-party domain
Artificial scarcity ('only 500 vouchers', 'expires at 5:00 PM')
Requests personal mobile number to 'redeem' free perks

safety_simulations.detail: Educational simulation recorded for Level 4 Prize and Giveaway Scams
safety_simulations.subject: Winner Notification: You were chosen for a $250 Tech Store Gift Card!
safety_simulations.preview: Your email was randomly chosen in our Youth Gaming Hardware Giveaway! Claim your $250 gift card and mystery box...
safety_simulations.simulated_body:
OFFICIAL WINNER ALERT!

Your email was randomly chosen in our Youth Gaming Hardware Giveaway! You have won a $250 Gaming Tech Gift Card + Mystery Loot Box!

To dispatch your prize package, please claim your ticket below. A small shipping handling fee of $3.99 is required to cover courier postage.
red_flags_identified: You won a high-value prize in a raffle or contest you never entered
Requires paying money ($3.99) upfront to receive a supposedly 'free' prize
High-value incentives used as psychological bait to capture credit card numbers

safety_simulations.detail: Educational simulation recorded for Level 5 Impersonation Scams
safety_simulations.subject: [SECURITY ALERT] Critical Trojan detected on your student laptop
safety_simulations.preview: Our network monitoring detected suspicious backdoor malware on your laptop. Run our emergency fix tool immediately...
safety_simulations.simulated_body:
ATTENTION STUDENT:

Our district network monitoring system detected suspicious backdoor malware attempting to transmit school files from your laptop.

Our IT support technicians are monitoring this alert. You must click the emergency link below immediately to run our online security fix and protect your student access credentials.
red_flags_identified: Impersonating official school IT staff with alarming fear tactics ('Trojan detected')
Instructs you to click a link or execute an unverified program ('trojan-patch.exe')
Fake technical jargon designed to panic the student into complying without thinking

safety_simulations.detail: Educational simulation recorded for Level 6 Deceptive Financial Offers
safety_simulations.subject: Exclusive Student Program: Turn $20 into $200 in 7 days (Guaranteed)
safety_simulations.preview: Ready to build wealth while studying? Our youth micro-crypto investment pool lets anyone turn $20 into $200 with zero risk...
safety_simulations.simulated_body:
Hey Future Mogul!

Ready to start building wealth while you study? Our student automated micro-crypto investment pool lets anyone turn $20 into $200 in just 7 days with zero risk.

Over 2,400 students joined this semester and are earning daily payouts. Registration closes at midnight tonight! Click below to secure your funded student slot.
red_flags_identified: Promises 'guaranteed' 10x returns with 'zero risk' (all genuine investments involve risk)
Artificial urgency ('registration closes at midnight tonight')
Targeted language aimed at youth FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out)
Classic Ponzi / pyramid scheme structure with fake social proof
